name: Musashi Ryouma
source:
A man who makes his living as a “corruptor." He uses drugs and forceful means to induce his targets to commit crimes without their knowledge or consent, and then uses this as leverage to extort them into committing crimes.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/onsenokami/index.html]official site[/url]]
